When is the FA Cup second round draw?
- Published
The draw for the second round proper of the FA Cup will take place on Monday, 9 November, before the final fixture of the first round between Plymouth Parkway and Berkhamsted.
TNT Sports will broadcast the draw live from Bolitho Park at approximately 18:45 GMT.
The fixtures for the second round proper will take place on the weekend of Saturday, 5 December.
Winners of the second round will receive £79,500 in prize money.
There is also a guaranteed £21,200 for the losing sides.
